levelProgression.name: Immovable + Temporary HP I
levelProgression.effect: For **2 Rounds** you become **Immovable** and gain **40 Temporary HP**. While Immovable you ignore Push, Pull, Prone, forced movement, and grapple-based forced moves.

levelProgression.name: Safe Movement I
levelProgression.effect: Move up to **8 m** along a legal ground path. This movement does not provoke movement-triggered Reactions.

levelProgression.name: Safe Movement II
levelProgression.effect: Move up to **14 m** along a legal ground path. This movement does not provoke movement-triggered Reactions.

system.lore: Ancestral weight, deep-road memory, and the old bond between dwarven bodies and stone.
system.description:
Ancestral weight, deep-road memory, and the old bond between dwarven bodies and stone.

A dwarf with Stonebound Soles cannot wear another Feet Artifact, magical boots, hooves, talons, or similar Feet-based Artifact.
